messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "tell laboratory staff you use venlafaxine"
set: ["tell laboratory staff you use venlafaxine", "inform laboratory staff of use", "inform doctor or laboratory staff of use", "inform laboratory staff about taking the medicine during drug screening", "venlafaxine", "tell your doctor if you also use", "allergy to venlafaxine", "Venlafaxine extended-release capsules", "allergic reaction to venlafaxine", "tell your doctor if you also use medicine to treat depression", "tell your doctor if you also use a narcotic (opioid) medication", "tell surgeon and dentist about use", "do not stop using venlafaxine suddenly", "other medicines containing venlafaxine or desvenlafaxine", "tell doctor if you develop breathlessness", "tell your doctor if you also use medicine to treat a psychiatric disorder"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
